description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases for the Git version control system, specifically testing object packing, indexing, unpacking, and verification functionalities. It sets up various scenarios, runs Git commands, and verifies expected outcomes, including handling of corrupted packs, strict mode operations, hash algorithms, and shared objects.

methods.name: check_deltas
methods.description: Function to check the number of delta objects in pack files by parsing stderr output.

methods.name: check_unpack
methods.description: Function to verify unpacked objects match expected list, handling unpack operation in a separate directory.

methods.name: check_use_objects
methods.description: Function to verify that objects in a pack are correctly unpacked and match expected content.

methods.name: test_with_bad_commit
methods.description: Function to test the behavior of index-pack with a intentionally malformed commit object, verifying detection of SHA1 collisions.
